author: Cool Worlds
description:
In the heart of New York City, physicists are making exotic states of quantum matter - states that have possibly never before occurred in the Universe. Today, as part of the 50x50 Science Across America series, Cool Worlds visits the coolest place of them all to see how this happens...

Check out the other 50x50 Science Across America videos at  ⁨@50x50Science⁩. Visit Prof Will's website at https://www.will-lab.com/

Presented by David Kipping. Edited by Jorge Casas.
